Criterion: Verify that all equipment and equipment racks are designed for proper electrical bonding and grounding. Standard: Bonding and grounding comply with standards as defined in MIL-STD-464C, 5.11 and 5.12 inclusive. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, and inspection. Analyses, tests and inspections verify proper bonding and grounding values. Documentation establishes appropriate bonding values to be maintained throughout system life, via drawings, specifications, maintenance manuals, etc. References: For guidance/principles regarding the provision of proper electrical bonding: JSSG-2001: 3.2.1, 4.2.1: 3.3.10.1.1, 4.3.10.1.1 JSSG-2009: 3.3; 3.3.4; E.4.4.5.1.3; E.3.4.5.1.11, E.4.4.5.1.11; E.3.4.5.8.7, E.4.4.5.8.7; E.3.4.5.8.11, E.4.4.5.8.11; G.3.4.7.2; G.3.4.7.6; G.4.4.7.6 MIL-HDBK-419 MIL-HDBK-454 MIL-STD-464C: A5.11, A5.12 MIL-STD-1310 SAE ARP1870

Standard: The air vehicle EWIS is installed IAW the bonding and grounding requirements of SAE AS50881, Ground Return paragraphs. All equipment and equipment racks are designed for proper electrical bonding and grounding IAW MIL-STD-464, Electrical Bonding paragraphs and External Grounds paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) An equipment installation drawings and models review verifies all equipment and equipment racks are properly electrically bonded and grounded.
(2) A wiring design documentation (e.g. schematics, drawings, and models) review verifies all EWIS is properly electrically bonded and grounded. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Bonding and grounding testing, using production or production representative components, verifies electrical bonding and grounding is IAW MIL-STD-464, Electrical Bonding paragraphs and External Grounds paragraphs.
  (2) Ground test: Air vehicle bonding and grounding ground testing verifies electrical bonding and grounding is IAW MIL-STD-464, Electrical Bonding paragraphs and External Grounds paragraphs.
